calculation: Single-Point Fault Metric (SPFM) target values by ASIL
formula_or_test: SPFM ≥ 90% (ASIL B), ≥ 97% (ASIL C), ≥ 99% (ASIL D); no quantitative target for ASIL A
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level

calculation: Latent-Fault Metric (LFM) target values by ASIL
formula_or_test: LFM ≥ 60% (ASIL B, recommended), ≥ 80% (ASIL C, recommended), ≥ 90% (ASIL D); no quantitative target for ASIL A
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level

calculation: Probabilistic Metric for random Hardware Failures (PMHF) target values by ASIL
formula_or_test: PMHF < 100 FIT (10^{-7}/h) for ASIL B/C; < 10 FIT (10^{-8}/h) for ASIL D; no quantitative target for ASIL A
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level

formula_or_test: SPFM = 1 − (Σλ_SPF + Σλ_RF) / Σλ_SR  (where λ_SR is sum of failure rates of safety-related hardware elements; safe faults excluded from both numerator and denominator)
authority: ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level
ISO 26262-5:2018 Road vehicles — Functional safety — Part 5: Product development at the hardware level

calculation: Total Processing Performance (TPP) for ECCN 3A090 classification
formula_or_test: TPP = 2 × MacTOPS × bit_length_of_the_operation, aggregated over all processing units on the IC; MacTOPS is theoretical peak tera (10^{12}) multiply-accumulate operations per second (D = A × B + C)
inputs: bit length of the operation (largest input bit-length to multiply)
authority: Export Administration Regulations (EAR), Commerce Control List, ECCN 3A090
volatility: thresholds and formula updated periodically via Federal Register (e.g., 2022–2025 rules)

formula_or_test: IC controlled if TPP ≥ 4800, or TPP ≥ 1600 and performance density ≥ 5.92 (performance density = TPP / applicable die area in mm^{2})
authority: Export Administration Regulations (EAR), Commerce Control List, ECCN 3A090
volatility: thresholds revised in successive AC/S rules (2022–2025)

formula_or_test: IC controlled if (TPP ≥ 2400 and < 4800 and performance density ≥ 1.6 and < 5.92) or (TPP ≥ 1600 and performance density ≥ 3.2 and < 5.92)
authority: Export Administration Regulations (EAR), Commerce Control List, ECCN 3A090
volatility: thresholds revised in successive AC/S rules (2022–2025)

calculation: Advanced Manufacturing Investment Credit amount (CHIPS Act)
formula_or_test: Credit = 25% of qualified investment (basis of qualified property placed in service that is part of an advanced manufacturing facility) for property placed in service after 31 Dec 2022 and on or before 31 Dec 2025; 35% thereafter
authority: 26 U.S.C. § 48D (Advanced manufacturing investment credit), as amended by CHIPS Act of 2022 and subsequent legislation
volatility: rate increased from 25% to 35% by 2025 legislation; construction begin-by date 31 Dec 2026

calculation: Temperature acceleration factor (Arrhenius model) for semiconductor reliability
formula_or_test: A_T = exp[(E_aa / k) × (1/T_U − 1/T_A)] where k = 8.617 × 10^{-5} eV/K, temperatures in Kelvin
authority: JEDEC JESD91 (Method for Developing Acceleration Models for Electronic Device Failure Mechanisms) / common industry practice referenced in JESD85
volatility: model form stable for decades; E_aa values mechanism-specific and updated with technology

calculation: FIT rate from accelerated life test data (chi-squared method)
formula_or_test: FIT = [χ^{2}(%CL, 2f+2) × 10^9] / (2 × t × ss × AF) where f = number of failures, t = test hours, ss = sample size, AF = acceleration factor
authority: JEDEC JESD85 (Methods for Calculating Failure Rates in Units of FITs)
volatility: calculation method stable; χ^{2} tables fixed

calculation: Primary-purpose test for advanced manufacturing facility under § 48D
formula_or_test: Primary purpose satisfied if more than 50% of the facility’s potential output (measured by costs of production, revenue in arm’s-length transaction, or units produced) is derived from manufacturing of semiconductors or semiconductor manufacturing equipment
inputs: fraction of potential output attributable to semiconductor or semiconductor-equipment manufacturing
volatility: threshold set in 2024 final regulations; may be refined by future guidance
